patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section featuring a large, elegant serif title on the left and a full-height, vibrant abstract illustration on the right.
Consistent use of an oversized, high-contrast display serif for primary headings, creating a strong visual anchor against a clean sans-serif for body text.
Strategic use of soft, pastel background colors (light green, light pink) to delineate content sections, contrasting with vibrant, abstract, full-bleed illustrations.
A distinct parallax effect on the hero illustration, where it scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down the page.
Alternating full-width sections of abstract, painterly illustrations and text blocks set against solid, pastel backgrounds, creating a rhythmic visual flow.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect where a large, abstract background illustration moves at a slower rate than the overlaying text, creating a dynamic sense of depth as the user scrolls.
Content sections are introduced with full-width background colors or full-bleed illustrations, using large, elegant serif headings as prominent visual anchors.

The site utilizes a JavaScript animation library (anime-js) to orchestrate scroll-triggered reveals, where content blocks appear to slide or fade into view as they enter the viewport, creating a guided reading experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body) with well-spaced, legible sans-serif body text, creating a significant contrast in size and character.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous padding around text blocks and significant vertical spacing between major sections.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the consistent pairing of vibrant, abstract, painterly illustrations with elegant, oversized serif typography. This creates a unique, artistic, and almost whimsical brand identity for a financial service, which typically uses more conservative or corporate design, making it highly memorable and emotionally engaging.
